lines.text: Mahabharat mein ek aisa Kaurav bhi tha, jisne apne hi sau bhaiyon ke khilaaf yuddh lada!
Woh Dhritarashtra ka putra aur Duryodhan ka sautela bhai tha.
Lekin Yuyutsu apne bhaiyon ki tarah anyaay ka saath nahi dena chahta tha.
Jab Kurukshetra mein yuddh shuru hone wala tha, tab Yudhishthir ne dono senaon ke saamne ghoshna ki—
"Jo bhi dharm ke paksh mein aana chahta hai, uska swaagat hai!"
Aur tabhi ek aisa yoddha aage aaya, jiski kisi ne kalpana bhi nahi ki thi.
Usne apne hi bhaiyon ka saath chhodkar Pandavon ki sena mein shaamil hone ka faisla kiya.
Athaarah dinon tak chale mahayuddh mein usne Pandavon ki or se yuddh kiya aur jeevit bach gaya.
Sochiye... jis parivaar mein janm liya, usi ke khilaaf khada hona kitna kathin raha hoga!
Kyunki Yuyutsu ne saabit kiya ki sahi aur galat ka faisla rishton se nahi, karmon se hota hai.
Aisi hi ansuni kahaniyon ke liye follow karein NEXORA!
